facts.fact: 章首：夜袭后他护着肋伤的 Andra 跌撞回房——撕衬衫包自己被撕烂的右臂
facts.anchor: Gerrick’s good arm wrapped under Andra’s waist as they stumbled into her room above the tavern.

facts.fact: 数字：触诊判定三根肋骨骨折
facts.anchor: “You have three broken ribs. What can I do to help you be more comfortable?” he asked softly.

facts.fact: 查肋时发现腹部粗糙缝合的新疤——追问来历
facts.anchor: Andra glanced down to see him studying the long, poorly stitched scar on her stomach.

facts.fact: 她坦白疤来自 Avernon“一个坏男人”——情绪崩溃落泪
facts.anchor: “It happened in Avernon. He… wasn’t a good man.”

facts.fact: “He's dead”出口 Gerrick 僵住——她最恨没能亲手救自己（就像今晚）
facts.anchor: “I wasn’t the one to kill him. I couldn’t save myself. And I hate myself for that.

facts.fact: 他嘴说不严重——上臂撕脱白骨外露；她坚持先救他
facts.anchor: “Not that bad? Gerrick, I can see your bone.”

facts.fact: 施疗：先洗澡洗头再青蓝药水逐滴愈臂（深层先行）；自服骨骼再生药水还需几天
facts.anchor: She administered the tonic by tiny droplets onto the wound, careful to heal the deeper areas first before moving upward.

facts.fact: 黎明兄弟闯入——Rayner 挑逗“Did you bag the hunter?”；Gerrick 澄清“是她治好了我”
facts.anchor: “She healed me.” Gerrick’s low timbre sounded from behind her.

facts.fact: Gyor 急报：补给员被“人”洗劫毒打（非怪物）——外面的人在绝望
facts.anchor: “No, men. They ransacked his supplies and beat him pretty badly. Said people are getting desperate out there.”

facts.fact: 数字：暗怪增至十倍、不再只找 Andra——没有人是安全的
facts.anchor: “Dark monsters are increasing tenfold. They’re no longer just searching for Andra. No one is safe.”

facts.fact: 章末：一小时内出发到马匹处集合
facts.anchor: “We need to leave within the hour. Gather all you can and meet me at the horses.”
